Preserve tracker provenance while undistorting canonical fish video tracks

Source: R/brown-lens-flatport.R
aqt_brown_undistort_tracks.Rd

Applies an externally fitted Brown perspective lens model to one pixel-space aqt_tracks object, retaining exact original detector pixels, timestamps, IDs and an explicit per-observation roundtrip error. Unknown and invalid fish positions stay unobserved. The resulting 2D pinhole pixels can enter the existing refractive multi-camera reconstruction only after independent cross-view identity and synchronization checks.

Usage

aqt_brown_undistort_tracks(tracks, lens, ...)

Arguments

tracks

aqt_tracks in 2D image coordinates and px units.

lens

aqt_brown_camera with camera-matched intrinsic K.

...

Inversion thresholds for aqt_brown_undistort_pixels().

Value

aqt_tracks containing undistorted x/y and original measured detector pixels in distorted_x_px/distorted_y_px.
